title: alyssum litorale f. molliusculum
intro: Alyssum litorale f. molliusculum, commonly known as sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative effects. The health benefits of Alyssum litorale f. molliusculum are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine and adaptogen, promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
